title: Use the tax withheld calculator
summary: Use the tax withheld calculator to determine the tax that needs to be withheld from payments made to employees or other workers.
intro:
If you want to work out the tax you need to withhold from payments you make to employees or other workers, you can use the tax withheld calculator.

The calculator takes into account:

To use the tax withheld calculator, you'll need your employee's or other worker's tax file number declaration, withholding declaration and Medicare levy variation declaration.

The calculator applies to payments made in the current tax year.
what_you_need: Your employee's or other worker's tax file number declaration
